verses.text: Praise the LORD! I’ll thank the LORD with my whole heart, among upright people gathered together and in the whole assembly.
The LORD’s works are great, and everyone who loves what he does takes time to think about them.
His work is full of honor and majesty. His righteousness lasts forever.
He’s made his wonders things people will remember. The LORD is gracious and merciful.
He’s given food to those who fear him. His covenant never slips his mind.
He showed his people how powerful his works are when he gave them the nations’ inheritance.
What he does with his hands is true and just. Every instruction he gives is reliable.
They’re set forever and ever, carried out in truth and uprightness.
He sent rescue to his people and established his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
Fearing the LORD is where wisdom starts. Everyone who follows his instructions has good sense. His praise goes on forever!
